title: Retrieve the current tote task using the Tote Management API (Get Tote Task)
summary: Use the Tote Management API function “Get Tote Task” on the Totes Aveva API page to retrieve the current tote task for a specified tote.
when_to_use: When you need to check what the system currently believes is the active task for a specific tote using the Tote Management API function “Get Tote Task”.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the Tote Management API “Get Tote Task” function for the specified tote and interpret whether a current tote task is returned.
access_or_tools_needed: Totes Aveva API page / “API Features for Tote Management”
Obeyba access (implied by the source login question)

access_required: Obeyba login/access to reach the Totes Aveva API page

visual_references.description: Totes Aveva API page showing the function list including “Get Tote Task” (and other tote management functions).

steps.title: Open the Tote Management API function list on the Totes Aveva API page
steps.purpose: Access the “API Features for Tote Management” function list so you can run “Get Tote Task”.
steps.instruction: Navigate to the “API Features for Tote Management” page on the Totes Aveva API screen and confirm you are logged in to Obeyba.
steps.expected_result: The function list is visible and includes “Get Tote Task”.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see “Get Tote Task” in the Tote Management API function list.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot see “Get Tote Task” (e.g., not logged in or wrong page).

actions.label: Verify login and function list
actions.exact_action: Are you logged in to Obeyba?

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot access the Totes Aveva API page / function list (including “Get Tote Task”), stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR shows “Get Tote Task … Retrieves the current tote task.” Nearby transcript includes: “Are you logged in to Obeyba?”

steps.title: Run “Get Tote Task” for the specified tote
steps.purpose: Retrieve the current tote task for the tote you are investigating.
steps.instruction: Locate the function labeled “Get Tote Task” on the Totes Aveva API page, then use it to retrieve the current tote task for the tote (provide the required tote identifier if the UI prompts for it).
steps.expected_result: The API returns the current tote task for the specified tote.
steps.healthy_condition: A “current tote task” result is returned for the tote you requested.
steps.failure_condition: The function does not return a current tote task for the specified tote.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the function does not return a current tote task, stop and escalate (no error-handling steps are provided by the source).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: "Get Tote Task" retrieves the current tote task.
OCR text includes: “Get Tote Task … Retrieves the current tote task.”

steps.title: Record the returned “current tote task” result
steps.purpose: Capture the retrieved tote task information for follow-up troubleshooting or escalation.
steps.instruction: Record the returned “current tote task” result for the tote you queried.
steps.expected_result: You have a recorded value/result representing the current tote task for that tote.
steps.healthy_condition: The recorded result corresponds to the tote you requested and reflects the returned “current tote task”.
steps.failure_condition: No result is recorded or the recorded result does not correspond to the tote queried.

actions.label: Record API output
actions.exact_action: Record the returned “current tote task” result

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot record a returned current tote task result (because none was returned), stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: "Get Tote Task" retrieves the current tote task.

success_criteria: “Get Tote Task” returns a current tote task result for the specified tote.
healthy_conditions: The API output includes a current tote task for the tote identifier you provided.
failure_conditions: The “Get Tote Task” function does not return a current tote task for the specified tote.
escalation_guidance: If “Get Tote Task” does not return a current tote task for the specified tote, stop and escalate (the source does not provide additional error-handling steps).
